title: Major Challenges for National Parks in India
subject: Geography
description: A mindmap illustrating the significant challenges threatening the ecological integrity of India's National Parks, such as human-wildlife conflict, poaching, climate change impacts, and infrastructure development.
mermaidCode:
mindmap
root((Major Challenges for National Parks))
  Human-Wildlife Conflict
    Crop raiding
    Livestock predation
    Retaliatory killings
  Poaching & Illegal Wildlife Trade
    Targeted hunting (tiger parts, rhino horn)
    High-value products
  Climate Change Impacts
    Altered precipitation patterns
    Increased forest fires
    Sea-level rise (coastal mangroves)
  Infrastructure Development
    Roads, dams, mining projects
    Habitat fragmentation
    Impede animal movement
  Inadequate Funding & Manpower
    Limited resources for patrolling
    Limited resources for research
    Limited resources for community outreach
